■ Stage Direction
SE: Cheers for Buena

Waaah! A-Are you alright!?
You're completely drenched!!
For I am... a saint!

Magnificent, Buena-san.
The wall you present truly knows no height.

Ngh...! Not yet...! As if this could stop me...!
Haaaaaaah!

Could this also be... a trial ordained for a saint...!?
Aaaahhhhh...!

Still, it's probably that very conviction that drives her to work so hard.
...What an intriguing girl. I made a mental note to speak with her if the opportunity arose.

Pay it no mind. This, too, is a trial for a saint.
Mere water cannot quench the holy red flame within me.

She had charged in with such utter confidence.
I thought even Red Desire would be crestfallen, but...
Leave everything to me, the Saint Red Desire...!

—Thank you all for celebrating with me!
Aw, shucks, I'm blushing. I still have a long way to go myself, though.

—I will not lose next time.
For I am, after all, a saint.

Incredible, receiving an award for training theory research despite being a rookie!
To think we joined at the same time... Some people really are just special, huh.

...Now, allow me to open the window.
Please, everyone, step back.
Now's the time! Hah...!

—Yet, victory eluded her.
The surrounding area erupted into cheers praising Buena Vista.

I'm not standing out at all. My skills are still sorely lacking.
In a state like this, taking on a trainee Umamusume would be premature...

Well, she's definitely taking first place. She's on a whole different level.
She really has that special aura, doesn't she! Ugh, can I even keep up?

—It wasn't! After a split second of calm,
a torrential, driving rain slammed in, rattling the windowpane!
(RUMBLE, RUMBLE... CRRRRRAAAASH!!)

Desire-chan!
Right back at you. I won't lose either.

Her name is Buena Vista. Already hailed as the heavy favorite
for next year's Tiara route, a candidate for the next generation's "Heroine."

What a gentle soul you are.
However, fear not. I am quite fine.

That adolescent conviction of believing oneself to be 'special'...
It felt somehow nostalgic, giving me a bittersweet tickle inside.

Yes...
I swear, I will overcome the trial that is you...!

Isn't the thunder getting closer? That's so scary!
Everyone! The instructor says to evacuate to the gym because it's dangerous!

I'm genuinely happy for my peer's success. There's no lie in that feeling.
...Yet, deep inside my chest, something quietly aches.

—Ah, please do not weep.
O heavens. What sorrow weighs upon you that you shed such cold tears?

Yet, I know...
Trials only come to those who are capable of overcoming them.

*pant*... *pant*...
I fell short once again...

Ngh—!
O destiny, please, let it stay like this...!

Buena-san, thank you for humoring me with this match.
I, Saint Red Desire, swear to give it my all...!

Ah! My shoelace snapped...!
I cannot run to class like this. Ugh, yet another trial...!

I'm so sorry! My hands slipped while carrying water for cleaning...!
I had no idea anyone was down here...

...After school on the day that happened,
I found myself lost in thought while watching the Umamusume train diligently.

This thunder is crazy. It's so scary...
Man, and I really wanted to run outside today~

—Even when night fell, I couldn't get those eyes out of my head.
She doesn't seem discouraged because she's "a saint," but still...

A few days later, Red Desire was in a practice race.
A wildly popular, highly anticipated prospect was also running in it...
(WHOOOOSH! RUMBLE-CRASH!)

Does she have immense confidence? ...And as the race neared its end,
Red Desire entered the final stretch in prime position!

Even blades of lightning...!
For such things to happen the moment I appear... Ha!

O heavens, O earth, O omnipresent spirits of "that land"...!
Grant mana's power to my prayer—!

Red Desire endures Buena Vista's phenomenal late surge.
Her running shows unmistakable skill, almost divine in its presence—

Ah... Aahh...! How wicked!
Ngh... It seems I have no choice but to endure for now.

For a second, I thought she was talking to me.
However, following her gaze, rain clouds were drifting across the sky...

Everyone, please lift your heads.
I shall go and calm the heavens with the power of holy prayer.

—Ever since that day,
I began noticing Red Desire around campus more and more.

That's our Buena-chan! I knew you'd win!
You're a total genius, after all!

Thanks for having me today, everyone.
I'll do my best to make it a great race!
